question.text: As per the post-issue Registrar duty described on page 110 of the NISM Series II-A (October 2025) workbook, within what time from the closure of the public issue must the Registrar collect the final certificates from all SCSBs?

answer.text: Within 5 working days of issue closure
Within 1 working day of issue closure
Within 2 working days of issue closure
Within 3 working days of issue closure

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 110 of the NISM Series II-A (October 2025) workbook states that the Registrar must collect the final certificates from all SCSBs within two working days from the closure of the issue. The stem is now anchored to that specific post-issue Registrar duty, so 2 working days is uniquely correct. The Trap: 1, 3, or 5 working days do not appear as the post-issue SCSB final-certificate timeline on p.110. The audit flagged the original because page 120's T+3 activity table separately sets final-certificate submission deadlines on T day itself (at 7:30 pm / 9:30 pm depending on channel) - so without specifying which framework was being tested, both "T-day deadline" and "within 2 working days" were defensible. Note: The original was ambiguous because pp.110 and 120 give two different timeline statements for the SCSB final-certificate step. The stem is now restricted to the post-issue Registrar duty on p.110, which uniquely supports "within 2 working days of issue closure".
